description: Utility functions for handling annotations in ECharts timeseries charts within the Superset project, including evaluation, parsing, extraction, and formatting of annotation data and labels.

methods.name: evalFormula
methods.description: Evaluates a formula annotation layer over data, returning pairs of x-axis values and evaluated expressions.

methods.name: parseAnnotationOpacity
methods.description: Converts annotation opacity levels to numeric opacity values.

methods.name: extractRecordAnnotations
methods.description: Extracts annotation records from annotation data based on annotation layer configuration.

methods.name: formatAnnotationLabel
methods.description: Formats annotation labels combining name, title, and descriptions into a string.

methods.name: extractAnnotationLabels
methods.description: Extracts names of annotation layers that are of type Formula or Timeseries and are set to show.

methods.name: getAnnotationData
methods.description: Retrieves annotation data from chart properties, returning an empty object if none exists.
